text:
Maria Gonzales: Quick RFC drop — proposal for SDK streaming + retry/backoff ergonomics. Want feedback on API shape, default retry semantics, and acceptance criteria. Link: https://rwd.internal/rfcs/stream-retries (draft)
Noah Patel: Skimmed. high-level looks good. main concern: how do we define idempotency for streamed calls? retries vs resume semantics need clarity.
Maria Gonzales: Agreed. Proposal sketch: two modes — "stateless retry" (replay whole request) and "resumable stream" (server supports resume tokens). Default: stateless for simplicity; resumable opt-in when model+server support resume tokens.
Sam Lee: Can we see a minimal client API? small example pls.
Maria Gonzales: Sure — rough:
```
const s = client.streamGenerate({
  model: 'redwood-7b',
  prompt: 'Summarize...',
  mode: 'resumable', // | 'stateless'
  retry: { maxRetries: 2, backoff: 'expo', baseMs: 200 },
  onDelta: (delta) => render(delta),
  onError: (err) => console.error(err),
  onDone: () => cleanup()
});
```
Noah Patel: API looks clean. Two points:
- Define error classes: transient (network, 5xx), permanent (4xx non-retryable, validation).
- For resumable: need server-provided resumeToken + client-side idempotency key to map attempts.
Jess Chen: QA notes: acceptance criteria must include deterministic replay tests and flaky-network integration tests (long tail reconnects, partial token duplication handling).
Maria Gonzales: Draft ACs in the doc (short):
- AC1: Default client config retries only on transient errors, <=2 attempts, exponential backoff with jitter.
- AC2: When mode='resumable' and server returns resumeToken, client reconnects using token and no duplicate deltas beyond tolerance.
- AC3: Cancellation API immediately closes socket and prevents retries.
- AC4: SDK exposes clear error types so callers can decide to retry/abort.
- AC5: Docs + migration guide for existing users.
Sam Lee: Implementation notes for DevEx:
- Expose small helper `withResumableStream` that wraps reconnect logic.
- Provide a polyfill for environments without StreamingHTTPRequest (mobile), fallback to chunked polling.
Noah Patel: Runtime infra items:
- Need server-side resume token (offset-based) and idempotency key support by API gateway.
- Graceful dedupe logic to avoid re-emitting tokens across reconnects.
Maria Gonzales: Rollout plan proposal:
- Phase 1: SDK opt-in 'stateless' + clear docs (2 weeks)
- Phase 2: Server resumeToken MVP + SDK resume plumbing (4 weeks)
- Phase 3: Hardening, QA, perf tests, and canary clients (2 weeks)
Jess Chen: Add tests:
- unit: retry logic + error classification
- integration: simulated socket drops at token N
- e2e: sample app + long-run soak
devex-bot: Reminder: add API docs to the SDK repo and create migration notes issue template.
Noah Patel: Edge cases:
- Partial token duplication: accept up to N repeated tokens then fail (configurable)
- Non-idempotent side effects: surface error to caller; default to no automatic replay
- Proxy timeouts: keep-alive ping and reconnect strategy
Sam Lee: UX question — should default mode be 'stateless' or 'resumable'? I vote stateless for safety.
Maria Gonzales: Leaning stateless default too. Resumable for medium/large responses & low-latency apps.
Jess Chen: One more AC: telemetry — record retries, resume success/failure, and dup token rate.
Maria Gonzales: Good call. I'll update the doc with ACs + simple sequence diagrams and a small pseudo impl of backoff. Please drop comments in the doc by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI passed for SDK unit tests on branch feature/stream-retries
Noah Patel: I'll put up a short RFC PR with the API surface and suggested tests.
Sam Lee: Happy to help implement the withResumableStream helper.
Maria Gonzales: Thanks team — assigning follow-ups in the RFC now.
